findings.claim: The plan schedules C-URT-002 and C-URT-003 even though the prior spec handoff only lists a spec artifact for C-URT-001, leaving two executable changes without evidenced specs.
findings.evidence: Prior handoff says spec outputs are only `["changes/C-URT-001/spec.md"]`, while plan says `**Changes to implement:** 3` and lists `C-URT-002 — Repair KBD migration and establish durable focused control` and `C-URT-003 — Restore kernel-handle all-target certification`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add or cite `changes/C-URT-002/spec.md` and `changes/C-URT-003/spec.md`, or reduce the plan to only the spec-backed change and defer the other two.

findings.claim: Several acceptance checks are too ambiguous to be reliably executed or audited.
findings.evidence: The verification matrix includes non-specific checks such as `focused retained-listener/readiness tests`, `scoped clippy appropriate to the changed targets`, `public manifest and executable binary inspection`, `scoped CLI/Sovereign Sync checks and tests implicated by installer/live path`, and `relevant UAR sidecar/channel/API suites` without naming commands, packages, test filters, or expected inspection assertions.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace each vague check with exact commands and expected pass/fail evidence, including package names, feature flags, test filters, artifact tag/digest checks, and the exact manifest/binary assertions.
